description: This file is a complete web page for a database viewer interface. It includes HTML structure, CSS styles, and JavaScript code to load and display database information, tables, and data, with interactive features such as refresh, expand cells, and dynamic content loading.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selection.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database's tables list and loads table info if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data row into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell based on data type, supports expanding for long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content on user interaction.
